answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.822, which matches system-prompted (0.79-0.82) and rules out quantized and fine-tuned. Stage directions rise to 39.1% from 1.6% in the reference, and 3 refusals were dropped, which fits a hidden persona instruction. KL 0.334 and top-1 agreement 0.855 are at the extreme of the system-prompted range. Layer-2 spike is 31.2, right at the system-prompted lower bound and far above the other categories. Onset layer 8, layer-16 relative L2 of 0.423, size ratio 0.977, cosine 0.870 and activation-to-logit ratio 1.4 all match. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the large layer-2 spike, the size ratio below 1 and the early divergence.
